updates.title: MA Money Transmitter License — Hard Money Compliance Deadline PASSED
updates.summary: M.G.L. c. 169B requires hard money lenders to obtain money transmitter licenses by July 1, 2026. Deadline has passed. Non-compliant lenders must immediately cease lending in MA.
updates.action: Verify MA money transmitter license status. If not licensed, cease MA hard money lending immediately and apply for license.

updates.title: OBBBA: 100% Bonus Depreciation Now Permanent (IRS Notice 2026-11/16)
updates.summary: The One Big Beautiful Bill Act made 100% bonus depreciation permanent for qualified property acquired after Jan 19, 2025. IRS Notice 2026-11 and 2026-16 provide implementation guidance.
updates.action: For all 2025+ real estate acquisitions: consider cost segregation studies and plan maximum depreciation deductions.

updates.title: MA Decouples from Federal Bonus Depreciation (2025-2026 Tax Years)
updates.summary: Massachusetts temporarily decouples from federal special depreciation allowance for qualified production property (QPP) in 2025-2026. Creates permanent state/federal mismatch.
updates.action: Track federal vs. state depreciation separately. Plan for permanent MA add-backs. Consult on amended returns if 2025 already filed.

updates.title: Massachusetts Surtax Threshold Increased to $1,107,750
updates.summary: The 4% surtax (9% total state tax) applies to income above $1,107,750 (increased from $1,083,150). Indexed annually.
updates.action: For high-income owners: review 2026 income projections and plan withholding adjustments if threshold will be exceeded.

updates.title: Opportunity Zones 2.0 Made Permanent (Effective Jan 1, 2027)
updates.summary: OBBBA made OZ program permanent and upgraded to 2.0 effective 1/1/27. SALT deduction cap increased to $40k (through 2029).
updates.action: Evaluate OZ 2.0 benefits for eligible 2026 acquisitions. Maximize $40k SALT cap through 2029.

updates.title: 2026 Section 179 Expensing Limits: $2.56M (Confirmed)
updates.summary: Section 179 limit remains $2,560,000 with phase-out at $4,090,000. Effective when combined with 100% bonus depreciation.
updates.action: Plan 2026 equipment purchases (carwash, lending infrastructure) with Section 179 elections.

updates.title: PMI Now Deductible as Mortgage Interest (Beginning 2026)
updates.summary: Private Mortgage Insurance (PMI) premiums treated as deductible mortgage interest beginning in 2026 (up to $750k loan cap).
updates.action: Track PMI on financed properties (e.g., fix-and-flips with high LTV loans) for deduction.
